limits.en: 10,000 credits/month, access to Text to Speech, Speech to Text, Sound Effects, Voice Design, Music, Productions, Image, up to 3 projects.

keyLimits.en: 30,000 credits/month, commercial license, instant voice cloning, 20 projects, dubbing studio.
600,000 credits/month, 44.1kHz PCM audio output via API, 192kbps quality audio.
1.8M credits/month, 3 workspace seats, team collaboration, 3 professional voice clones.
6M credits/month, low-latency TTS (~5 cents/minute), 10 professional voice clones, 10 workspace seats.
Custom credits, custom terms and DPA/SLA assurances, BAAs for HIPAA customers.

cautions.en: Pricing is usage-based via a monthly credit allowance that is consumed by text-to-speech, dubbing and other generative features; heavy use of high-quality voices or dubbing can exhaust credits before the month ends.
The Creator plan page showed a promotional '50% off first month' banner ($11 instead of $22); the regular price ($22/mo) was used here, not the promo.

capabilities.en: Text-to-speech synthesis with a large library of AI voices and multiple languages.
Instant and professional voice cloning for creating custom AI voices.
Dubbing Studio for translating and re-voicing video/audio content across languages.
Speech-to-text, sound effects generation and AI music generation included in the same platform.

limitations.en: Free plan credits (10,000/month) are consumed quickly by longer audio generations, limiting sustained use.
Professional voice cloning, needed for the highest-fidelity custom voices, is gated behind the Creator plan and above.

reason.en: OpenAI's speech-to-text model, overlapping with ElevenLabs' transcription capability.
Audio/video editing tool with AI voice and dubbing features targeting similar creator workflows.
AI audio generation platform, overlapping on the music-generation side.

unknowns: Exact credit-to-audio-minute conversion rate (how many credits one minute of speech consumes) was not detailed on the pricing page in this session.
